newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials look set to open down after data.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials look set to open down after data.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average looked set to trend lower at the open on Thursday, after the release of core CPI and industrial production data.

The core Consumer Price Index came in slightly above expectations, up 0.3 percent versus a forecast gain of 0.2 percent. Industrial production in April was unchanged from March, versus an expected rise of 0.2 percent.
"The industrial production data will still probably play second fiddle to the CPI data, and on balance, the market is due to back off a bit," Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co said.
